name: Classic
lede: Our original masterpiece — a breathtaking ride that perfectly fuses timeless elegance with modern craftsmanship.
body: The Classic is our original masterpiece — a breathtaking ride that perfectly fuses timeless elegance with modern craftsmanship. Every model fuses bold aesthetics with raw, instantaneous performance, delivering exhilarating speed, torque, and rock-solid reliability. The result is a stunning, stylish ride that demands attention and is the true embodiment of sophistication.
detail_intro: The EGO Classic stands on the foundation of our initial design commitment: creating enduring quality. Our team has continually enhanced this signature model, ensuring it remains an iconic benchmark for timeless style and robust construction.
motor: Our own designed high-performance electric motor delivers instant torque and smooth acceleration like no other — compact, efficient, brushless, and built for fast, eco-friendly commuting, cruising, or adventure seeking.
battery: A lithium battery with impressive energy storage, paired with a Battery Management System that constantly monitors voltage, current, and temperature — preventing overcharging and boosting performance and longevity.
controller: An advanced electronic device that precisely manages complex systems using sophisticated algorithms, sensors, and real-time monitoring, with app connectivity and adaptive capabilities.
charger: An intelligent charger that quickly and safely recharges batteries using adaptive algorithms, temperature control, and real-time monitoring — extending battery life and enabling remote management.
